title: Faculty Login with JWT Authentication
description: As a faculty member, I want to log in securely so that I can access my appraisal dashboard.

acceptance_criteria.description: Given valid credentials, when I log in, then I receive a JWT token.
Given invalid credentials, when I log in, then I see an error message.
Given expired token, when I access a protected route, then I am redirected to login.

title: Faculty Research Submission Portal
description: As a faculty member, I want to submit my research publications so that they are recorded in my appraisal profile.

acceptance_criteria.description: Given a valid DOI, when I submit a publication, then it is added to my profile.
Given a duplicate DOI, when I submit, then I receive a duplication warning.
Given a submitted publication, when I view my profile, then I see the citation count.
Given an invalid DOI format, when I submit, then I see a validation error.

title: Teaching Load Records Management
description: As a department head, I want to record teaching loads for each faculty so that appraisals reflect actual contributions.

acceptance_criteria.description: Given a faculty member, when I add a course, then the teaching load is updated.
Given a teaching record, when I edit hours, then changes are persisted correctly.
Given a semester range, when I request a report, then I see aggregated teaching hours.

title: Admin Appraisal Dashboard with Analytics
description: As an administrator, I want a real-time dashboard showing appraisal progress so that I can monitor faculty performance trends.

acceptance_criteria.description: Given multiple faculty records, when I open the dashboard, then I see summary KPIs.
Given a date filter, when I apply it, then the dashboard data updates accordingly.
Given a department filter, when I select a department, then only that department's data is shown.
Given large datasets, when the dashboard loads, then it renders within 3 seconds.
Given exported data, when I download as CSV, then all visible rows are included.

title: Automated Appraisal Score Calculation
description: As a system, I want to automatically calculate composite appraisal scores so that evaluations are objective and consistent.

acceptance_criteria.description: Given research, teaching, and service weights, when I calculate, then the composite score is correct.
Given a faculty member with no research, when I calculate, then the score is not null.
Given custom weight configurations, when I save and recalculate, then scores update accordingly.
